messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222. An overdose can be fatal.
Overdose symptoms may include headache, leg cramps, tremors, feeling nervous or irritable, confusion, chest pain, shortness of breath, fast or pounding heartbeats, stroke, seizures, shock, and coma. Symptoms may not appear straight away and can take several days to develop, so get medical advice even if the person seems well.
Triplet: ["Levothyroxine", "has overdose note", "symptoms may not appear straight away and can take several days to develop"]

The relation 'has overdose note' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has a note or additional information specified by the object entity related to overdose.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has reference': The subject drug has a reference or additional information source specified by the object entity.
C. 'has overdose instruction': In case of an overdose of the subject drug the patient should follow the instruction specified by the object entity.
D. 'has overdose risk': An overdose of the subject drug may result in the serious or life-threatening consequence specified by the object entity.
E. 'can reveal': The subject drug may uncover or make apparent the medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
